After this diff the tag-assignment doors (POST/DELETE `/:type/:slug/tags`) use `assertTaggableType` → `400 VALIDATION`; only `GET /:type/:slug/tags` keeps `assertType`. The comment now contradicts the new guard 15 lines below — narrow it to the routes that still call `assertType` (version, collection, the tag read).
